## Moelis Hires Tom Moxham to Lead its EMEA Infrastructure Advisory Business


*Strengthens the Firm’s senior infrastructure and transport sector coverage and advisory capabilities*


London


, October 19, 2026


– Moelis & Company (NYSE: MC), a leading global independent investment bank, today announced the appointment of Tom Moxham as a Managing Director and EMEA Head of Infrastructure, based in London. Tom will lead the Firm’s infrastructure advisory business across EMEA, with a particular focus on the transport and core plus infrastructure sectors.


Tom brings over 20 years of investment banking and corporate finance experience advising infrastructure funds, pension funds, sovereign wealth funds and corporate clients on M&A and strategic transactions in the wider infrastructure sector. He joins Moelis from Deutsche Bank, where he spent more than 16 years and most recently acted as EMEA Head of Infrastructure & Utilities investment banking.


Matt Prest, Head of Europe and Asia at Moelis, said, “We’re pleased to welcome Tom to Moelis. He has deep expertise in both transport and wider infrastructure M&A and longstanding relationships with leading investors and corporates across Europe. His appointment builds on our global capabilities and enhances our ability to serve clients throughout the region.”


## About Moelis & Company


Moelis & Company (“Moelis”) is a leading global independent investment bank that provides innovative strategic advice and solutions to a diverse client base, including corporations, governments, and financial sponsors. The Firm assists its clients in achieving their strategic goals by offering comprehensive integrated financial advisory services across all major industry sectors. Moelis’s experienced professionals advise clients on their most critical decisions, including mergers and acquisitions, recapitalizations and restructurings, capital markets transactions, secondary transactions and primary fundraising, and other corporate finance matters. The Firm serves clients from locations across North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. For further information, please visit:[www.moelis.com](http://www.moelis.com/) .
